render_array: render an ndarray to a displayable HTML object with configurable rows, columns, and sliders
render_array_sharding: render the sharding of an array as a visual representation of device assignments
render_sharding_info: render sharding info for an array with explicit row and column axis ordering
integer_digitbox: render a single integer as nested colored squares with an optional label
default_sequential_colormap: get the default Viridis sequential colormap for continuous array visualization
